page_title: LEV 1-2 AUG | Bayer Leverkusen v Augsburg 18/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+11' Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Finn Dahmen shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
90+7' 1 - 2 Goal! Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mark Flekken into left side of the goal.
90+7' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+6' Montrell Culbreath (Bayer Leverkusen) tackles a bit over-zealously and Benjamin Brand blows for a foul. Penalty awarded! Augsburg will take a penalty kick.
90+5' The corner is swung in but Bayer Leverkusen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+5' Montrell Culbreath (Bayer Leverkusen) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball is out of play and Bayer Leverkusen manage to earn a corner.

90+4' The ball spins to Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
90+3' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
90+3' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
90+2' Augsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+2' The attendance for today's match is 29282.

90+1' Mert Komur (Augsburg) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Mark Flekken, who tips the ball around the post. Good work from Augsburg as they win a corner.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Finn Dahmen, who smothers the ball.

89' Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
86' Referee Benjamin Brand reverses his original decision after the VAR review. There was no infringement and subsequently it’s not a penalty.
86' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Benjamin Brand's book.
86' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.
84' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) handles the ball inside the penalty area. Bayer Leverkusen are about to take a penalty!
83' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen).
82' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Anton Kade walks off the pitch to be replaced by Mert Komur (Augsburg).
82' Here's the change. Robin Fellhauer leaves the pitch and Marius Wolf (Augsburg) comes on as a substitute.
81' Kasper Hjulmand has decided to make a change. Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Nathan Tella.
81' Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Exequiel Palacios.
81' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
80' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a short corner kick.
80' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen). The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner kick.
80' Bayer Leverkusen are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.

76' Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
74' Manuel Baum has decided to substitute Rodrigo Ribeiro and he is replaced by Uchenna Ogundu (Augsburg).
74' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) works the corner short.

73' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Finn Dahmen, who pulls off a comfortable save!
72' Substitution. Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) in, Jarell Quansah out.

70' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
69' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
69' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. They send men into the box.

68' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) misses a big chance! He fires the ball high over the crossbar from inside the 6-yard box after the ball rebounded to him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
66' The resulting set piece from Bayer Leverkusen is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
66' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Bayer Leverkusen have a corner.
65' Substitution. Lucas Vazquez makes his way off the pitch and Montrell Culbreath (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on as his replacement.
64' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but Mark Flekken comes off his line to gather the ball.
62' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
60' The substitution has been made. Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) has replaced Alexis Claude-Maurice.
59' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Finn Dahmen.
58' Finn Dahmen (Augsburg) is able to continue to play.
57' Finn Dahmen (Augsburg) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

56' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies towards the middle of the goal, but it's kept out by magnificent save from Finn Dahmen.
54' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
53' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
52' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.

52' Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Mark Flekken thwarts him with a great two-handed save.

50' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) inside the box. He lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Mark Flekken was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
49' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) commits a rough challenge and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for an infringement.
48' Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) is booked.
47' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.

45+2' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the bottom left corner. Unfortunately for him, Finn Dahmen shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
45+1' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

45+1' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
42' Lucas Vazquez (Bayer Leverkusen) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
40' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball has crossed the sideline. Augsburg are taking a throw-in.

38' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.

37' What a big chance! Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
35' A clumsy foul by Arthur Chaves (Augsburg) and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle.
34' PENALTY APPEAL after Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

32' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) meets a cross from Lucas Vazquez, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.

30' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the right post. His effort, however, is blocked by Finn Dahmen, who pulls off a stunning save!
30' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes it short.
30' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Bayer Leverkusen earn a corner.
28' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
26' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) brings an opponent down and Benjamin Brand interrupts the game.

24' Ambitious effort from Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
23' The corner by Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
22' An attempted cross from Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) is cleared. Corner kick. Augsburg will have an opportunity.
21' The game is interrupted as Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is flagged offside.
21' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
20' Lucas Vazquez (Bayer Leverkusen) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

20' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
19' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

18' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
17' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
15' 1 - 1 Goal! Dimitrios Giannoulis slips it to Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) on the edge of the box and he finds the top of the net with a great effort. The score is 1:1.
15' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) will deliver the corner kick.
15' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Augsburg get a corner.
12' 1 - 0 Goal! Edmond Tapsoba plays a hopeful cross into a crowded box. Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) times his jump perfectly and sends a header into the roof of the net from close in. 1:0.
11' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Lucas Vazquez (Bayer Leverkusen) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
9' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) will take the corner.

8' Lucas Vazquez (Bayer Leverkusen) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayer Leverkusen.
6' A pass by Anton Kade (Augsburg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Bayer Leverkusen.
6' A raking crossfield pass from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
3' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

3' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a yard for himself as he picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and quickly sends a shot towards the underside of the crossbar. The opponent's goalkeeper pulls off a remarkable save to keep the ball from hitting the net. What a save! It will be a corner kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
